name: viborm
description: Type-safe ORM for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite with a Prisma-inspired API

scripts.test:coverage:policy: node scripts/run-node-safe.mjs 512 60000 scripts/coverage-policy.test.mjs && node scripts/run-node-safe.mjs 512 60000 scripts/bounded-process.test.mjs && node scripts/run-node-safe.mjs 512 60000 scripts/test-run-lock.test.mjs && node scripts/run-node-safe.mjs 512 60000 scripts/raptor3-refusal-census.test.mjs
scripts.test:package: pnpm package:build && VIBORM_PACKAGE_PART=runtime node scripts/run-vitest-safe.mjs run --workspace vitest.workspace.ts --project=package && VIBORM_PACKAGE_PART=types node scripts/run-vitest-safe.mjs run --workspace vitest.workspace.ts --project=package
scripts.db:run: docker run -d --name baseorm -p 2222:5432 -e POSTGRES_DB=baseorm -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=password postgres
